version_scope.note: The official public DeviceManagementService V2.4 PDF identifies the publication as DMS but its foreword contains copied HtmlDisplayService identity and purpose text.
Candidate/integration XSD context is used only as corroborating service-identity context. It is not an official V2.4 release authority and does not make the foreword defect executable.

semantic_basis.note: Pinned pages 1 and 3 establish the publication as DeviceManagementService V2.4; page 4 visibly states in German and English that the document describes HtmlDisplayService, and the English paragraph additionally describes HTML/web-server display purpose.

The copied HtmlDisplayService identity and HTML/web-server purpose are incompatible with the DMS document identity, DMS operation inventory and the remainder of the DeviceManagementService publication.

The repository DMS V2.4 XSD family is explicitly candidate/integration only. EV-108 corroborates DMS structure identity but is not promoted to official-release authority and does not define this documentation-only defect.

The strongest alternative explanation—that HtmlDisplayService is merely a related-service reference—is rejected because the foreword says the document describes that service and reproduces its service-purpose prose.

de.title: DMS V2.4: Vorwort beschreibt fälschlich den HtmlDisplayService
de.short: Die offizielle DMS-V2.4-PDF enthält im Vorwort kopierten HtmlDisplayService-Identitäts- und Zwecktext.
de.long: Die Seiten 1 und 3 der gepinnten Veröffentlichung identifizieren das Dokument eindeutig als DeviceManagementService V2.4. Im Vorwort auf Seite 4 steht jedoch in beiden Sprachfassungen, dass das Dokument den HtmlDisplayService beschreibt; der englische Absatz übernimmt zusätzlich dessen HTML-/Webserver-Zweck. Der alternative Erklärungsversuch einer bloßen Querverweisung passt nicht zu dieser Formulierung und dem kopierten Zwecktext. Es handelt sich daher um einen bestätigten Copy/Paste-Dokumentationsfehler ohne XML-Validierungswirkung.
de.recommendation: Aus dem Vorwort keine HtmlDisplay-Routen, Operationen oder XML-Aliase für DMS ableiten. Für SDK-Laufzeitvalidierung keinen eigenen Fehler erzeugen; den Befund nur als Dokumentations-/Providerhinweis und für spätere externe Korrekturtriage führen.

en.title: DMS V2.4: foreword incorrectly describes HtmlDisplayService
en.short: The official DMS V2.4 PDF contains copied HtmlDisplayService identity and purpose text in its foreword.
en.long: Pages 1 and 3 of the pinned publication unambiguously identify the document as DeviceManagementService V2.4. Page 4 nevertheless states in both language sections that the document describes HtmlDisplayService, and the English paragraph additionally carries its HTML/web-server purpose. The alternative explanation of a mere related-service reference does not fit that identity statement and copied purpose text. This is therefore a confirmed copy/paste documentation defect with no XML-validation effect.
en.recommendation: Do not derive HtmlDisplay routes, operations or XML aliases for DMS from the foreword. Do not emit a dedicated SDK runtime validation error; retain the finding as documentation/provider context and for later external-correction triage.
